summary: HTMLMediaElement now better handles audio-session interruptions and records per-source resume behavior, reflects runtime muted-content changes into native media controls, and implements the proposed loading attribute for <audio> and <video> (the hint for when to load media). The runtime-muted-content fallback is gated behind a Nightly-only preference _for now_, and telemetry was added so the browser can learn how often the runtime mute affects playback.
